Located on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Mustafar]], '''Tulrus Island''' was surrounded by tall [[mountain]]s, and was one of the few contant features of the [[Magma|lava]] world.<ref name="BMF17" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tulrus Island was first mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 17|seventeenth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine,<ref name="BMF17" /> published around [[April 29]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdates">{{BuildFalconDates|17}}</ref> The [[Tulrus Nesting Grounds|Tulrus Isle]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it appeared in the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', as part of its [[2005]] expansion, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']].<ref name="SWG">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>
